Stationarity gives Hprime(0+)=M40/2>0. A is a 2x2 slow-mode generator with eigenvalue -z where gamma=(1-z)/(z(2-z)); exact Routh–Hurwitz positivity of all six quartic inequalities after u=z/(1-z) proves each cubic block mode decays faster. Independent symbolic calculation rederived all six nonnegative coefficient lists, reconstructed the rational slow residue L(z) at representative gamma=1/2,1,5,10, and verified the transformed degree-eleven P polynomial has exactly one sign change and opposite endpoint signs. The unique-root Descartes and denominator signs yield the all-gamma classification; finite samples are not a universal proof. Critical gamma next-slowest term and potential intermediate-lag negatives below gamma* are explicitly not classified.
